description: This is a Java interface named Response in the package com.romraider.logger.ecu.comms.query. It defines methods related to handling response data in an ECU communication context, including setting data values, retrieving data sets, getting data values, and timestamps.

classes.name: Response
classes.description: Java interface for ECU communication responses, defining methods for managing logger data and timestamps.

methods.name: setDataValue
methods.description: Sets the value for a specific LoggerData item.

methods.name: getData
methods.description: Returns the set of LoggerData items associated with this response.

methods.name: getDataValue
methods.description: Retrieves the value associated with a specific LoggerData item.

methods.name: getTimestamp
methods.description: Returns the timestamp of the response.
